content:
The Subscriber API lets an ISP's CRM / BSS programmatically manage subscribers, their gateway hosts, and service plans on the UniFi Carrier Fabric, authenticated with an API key.


## Get started with AI

Paste this into Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI assistant for a guided walkthrough of this API.

```
Read https://developer.ui.com/carrier-fabric/v1.0.0/ai-gettingstarted.md and follow the instructions to help the user onboard.
```


## Authentication

Every request is authenticated with an API key sent in the `X-API-Key` header:

```
X-API-Key: <your-key>
```

There is no cookie or session auth on this surface. A missing, malformed, unknown, expired, or revoked key returns `401`.


### Getting an API key

API keys are created in the UniFi Site Manager, the same way as for the [Site Manager API](https://developer.ui.com/site-manager/v1.0.0/gettingstarted):

1. Sign in to the UniFi Site Manager at [unifi.ui.com](https://unifi.ui.com/).
2. Click **API** in the left navigation bar.
3. Click **Create API Key**.
4. Copy the key and store it securely — it is shown only once. Click **Done** to hash and store it.

To call the Subscriber API, the key must belong to your **ISP fabric organization** and carry the subscriber scopes below.


### Scopes

A key carries a whitelist of scopes chosen at creation. Grant exactly the scopes your integration needs; a call whose required scope is not on the key returns `403`.

| Scope | Grants |
| --- | --- |
| `read:subscribers` | Read subscriber information (list, get) |
| `create:subscribers` | Create subscribers |
| `update:subscribers` | Update subscribers; attach / detach the gateway host |
| `read:plans` | Read service plans |
| `assign:plans` | Assign a service plan to a subscriber |
| `suspend:service` | Suspend a subscriber's service |
| `resume:service` | Resume a subscriber's service |

Scope names are colon-delimited exactly as shown. The required scope is listed per endpoint below.


### Request bodies

`POST /subscribers` and `PATCH /subscribers/\{id\}` are strictly validated: a property that isn't in the documented schema is rejected with `400 validation_failed`, not silently ignored. Send exactly the fields listed under [Examples](https://developer.ui.com/carrier-fabric/v1.0.0/examples).


## Rate limits

The API shares the UniFi Site Manager API rate limit: **10,000 requests per minute** per key. When you exceed it, the response is `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header — wait the indicated number of seconds, then retry.


## Endpoints

All paths are relative to `https://api.ui.com/v1/carrier`. The required scope is shown per endpoint.


### Subscribers

| Method & path | Scope | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST /subscribers` | `create:subscribers` | Create a subscriber (`subscriberNumber` required; no gateway host at create). |
| `GET /subscribers` | `read:subscribers` | List subscribers (cursor-paginated, filterable, sortable). `limit` (alias `pageSize`) must be **1–500**, default 50; anything outside that — non-numeric, below 1, or above 500 — is a `400` naming the bound. A malformed `planId` is also a `400`. |
| `GET /subscribers/\{id\}` | `read:subscribers` | Get one subscriber. |
| `PATCH /subscribers/\{id\}` | `update:subscribers` | Update mutable fields. Absent = unchanged; JSON `null` clears `name` / `email` / `notes` / `serviceAddress` / `planId`. `subscriberNumber` cannot be cleared (`null`/empty is a `400`), and `metadata` is a whole-document replace that `null` leaves untouched. See [Examples](https://developer.ui.com/carrier-fabric/v1.0.0/examples) for the full table. |
| `PUT /subscribers/\{id\}/host` | `update:subscribers` | Attach or re-link the gateway host. NOT idempotent — re-sending the host already attached is `409 gateway_already_attached`. |
| `DELETE /subscribers/\{id\}/host` | `update:subscribers` | Detach the gateway host. NOT idempotent — no host linked is `409 no_attached_host`. |
| `PUT /subscribers/\{id\}/plan` | `assign:plans` | Assign the service plan. |
| `POST /subscribers/\{id\}/suspend` | `suspend:service` | Suspend the subscriber's service (idempotent). |
| `POST /subscribers/\{id\}/resume` | `resume:service` | Resume the subscriber's service (idempotent). |


### Service plans

| Method & path | Scope | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /service-plans` | `read:plans` | List the organization's service plans. |
| `GET /service-plans/\{id\}` | `read:plans` | Get one service plan. |

A subscriber has at most one gateway host and one service plan, both at the subscriber level. Suspend and resume apply to the whole subscriber. The computed `state` field is one of `pending_assignment`, `provisioned` (a gateway has been pre-assigned but no host is linked yet), `installed` (a gateway host is linked), or `suspended`.

See [Examples](https://developer.ui.com/carrier-fabric/v1.0.0/examples) for request/response walkthroughs and [Error Handling](https://developer.ui.com/carrier-fabric/v1.0.0/error-handling) for the error format.
